react:.:createCheloneRouter: intended: builds a react-router router outside the React tree; a Vue app hands <Admin> its own vue-router
react:.:useAdminChildren: intended: partitions <Admin>'s React children into resources, routes and slots; Vue's <Admin> reads resources from the registry and its pages from slots
react:.:useAdminUI: intended: the shell content a custom React routing engine renders; Vue routes through vue-router, which has no shell content to read
react:.:useArrayInputResult: intended: lets a separate <SimpleFormIterator> read the <ArrayInput> binding; Vue folds the iterator into <ArrayInput>
react:.:useClearableFieldValue: gap: Vue has no shared clear-button helper; resettable-text-input, search-input and rating-field each re-derive the value read and the clear write
react:.:useCreateContext: gap: Vue's <Create> publishes no ambient create surface, so a Vue descendant cannot read the seed record, title or save
react:.:useCreateForm: gap: Vue exports no bridge for core's createCreateFormController; its <Create> wires useCreateController and useForm separately
react:.:useEditContext: gap: Vue's <Edit> publishes no ambient edit surface, so a Vue descendant cannot read the record, title or save
react:.:useEditForm: gap: Vue exports no bridge for core's createEditFormController; its <Edit> wires useEditController and useForm separately
react:.:useEvent: intended: a stable-identity callback for React memo and effect deps; a Vue callback needs no such pinning
react:.:useFieldError: intended: the ra call shape React's ported inputs use; Vue's useInput hands back the error already normalized
react:.:useFilterContext: intended: the ambient filter element nodes are React children; Vue's <FilterForm> takes a filters prop and a slot
react:.:useFilterForm: gap: Vue's <FilterForm> builds the live filter form inline, so a Vue app has no composable to build its own
react:.:useFormController: intended: React's attach-and-slices bridge for a core FormController; Vue reaches the same with useSubscribable over the controller
react:.:useGetChoiceRepresentationText: gap: Vue has no choice-representation text resolver, so its choice inputs default optionText to the name path, not the resource's recordRepresentation
react:.:useListFilterContext: intended: a re-selection of the one list context; Vue reads the filter slice off its reactive useListContext result
react:.:useListPaginationContext: intended: a re-selection of the one list context; Vue reads the pagination slice off its reactive useListContext result
react:.:useListSortContext: intended: a re-selection of the one list context; Vue reads the sort slice off its reactive useListContext result
react:.:useOptionalShowContext: gap: Vue publishes no show context, so a Vue component has nothing to read the ambient show surface from
react:.:useRegisterResources: intended: registers the <Resource> elements React walks out of <Admin>'s children; Vue's <Resource> registers itself through useResourceRegistry
react:.:useResolvedChildren: intended: resolves <Admin>'s sync or async function children into a React node; Vue's <Admin> has no children to resolve
react:.:useResolvedTheme: intended: React reads its theme context through a hook; Vue calls the exported resolveTheme on its reactive useTheme ref
react:.:useResourceSourceScope: intended: React carries the field label key in the source scope; Vue's useTranslateLabel builds resources.<resource>.fields.<source> at the label read
react:.:useResourceTranslation: gap: Vue has no resource-scoped label resolver with a base-key fallback and a userText override; useTranslateLabel covers field labels only
react:.:useRevalidate: intended: re-runs a server-rendered route's data for a React server component island; Vue has no server components
react:.:useSaveContext: gap: Vue publishes no ambient save surface; its SaveButton submits the form context, so a component outside the form cannot reach the view's save or saving state
react:.:useScrollToTop: gap: Vue sets the _scrollToTop navigation state but nothing reads it, so a Vue navigation never scrolls to the top and lists keep no scroll memory
react:.:useShowContext: gap: Vue's <Show> publishes no ambient show surface, so a Vue descendant cannot read the record or title
react:.:useSplatPathBase: intended: React folds location and params into one hook; Vue composes useLocation, useParams and the exported splatBase
react:.:useUnselect: intended: a ra-shaped unselect(ids) over React's list context; Vue's list surface exposes toggleItem and unselectAll directly
react:.:useWatch: intended: a react-hook-form compat name for a live form-value read; Vue has no react-hook-form call site to port
vue:./maps:useMapMarker: intended: Vue adds a pin through a composable; React renders a <MapMarker> child of <MapCanvas>
vue:.:createResourceRegistry: intended: Vue's registry is a shallowReactive map its route builder watches; a React app builds one from core's createResourceRegistry
vue:.:useChart: gap: React keeps its chart context hook private in packages/react/src/components/ui/chart.tsx, so a React app cannot read the chart config from its own chart part
vue:.:useChoiceInput: gap: React has no shared choice-input composable; each choice input wires useChoicesContext, useChoices and the text resolver itself
vue:.:useCommand: intended: Vue's dependency-free <Command> threads its search state through an injected contract; React's <Command> is Radix, which owns it
vue:.:useDataTablePass: gap: React keeps its header and data render-pass read private in packages/react/src/components/admin/list/data-table.tsx, so a custom React column cannot tell which pass it renders in
vue:.:useDropdownMenu: intended: Vue's dependency-free <DropdownMenu> threads its open state through an injected contract; React's is Radix, which owns it
vue:.:useMenuAccess: gap: React has the hook in packages/react/src/components/admin/layout/use-menu-access.ts but exports it from no entry, so a React app cannot run a no-throw access check
vue:.:useMicroStore: intended: Vue's reactivity bridge over a core MicroStore; React subscribes through useSyncExternalStore in each hook
vue:.:useMicroStoreSelector: intended: Vue's slice bridge over a core MicroStore; React uses useSyncExternalStoreWithSelector in each hook
vue:.:useOptionalCheloneFormContext: gap: React has the hook in packages/react/src/form-context.tsx but exports it from no entry, so a React component cannot read the ambient form without throwing
vue:.:useRecordContextRef: intended: Vue's reactive form of useRecordContext, which its injected record ref needs; React re-reads its context each render
vue:.:useRedirectOptional: gap: React has the hook in packages/react/src/router/nav-hooks.tsx but exports it from no entry, so a React standalone form cannot wire the controller's redirect without a router
vue:.:useRequiredResource: intended: Vue's controllers call it for the missing-resource throw; each React view writes that throw inline
vue:.:useRouterAdapterOptional: intended: React reads the exported RouterAdapterContext with useContext; Vue needs a named composable for the same null-tolerant read
vue:.:useSidebar: gap: React keeps its sidebar context hooks private in packages/react/src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx, so a React app cannot read the sidebar state from its own part
vue:.:useSubscribable: intended: Vue's ref bridge over a core subscribable; React subscribes inside each hook
vue:.:useTabs: intended: Vue's dependency-free <Tabs> threads its active value through an injected contract; React's <Tabs> is Radix, which owns it
